# Script to save the gene sequences from different species extracted from the TOGA or NCBI into a single fasta. This will create the gene multi-fasta file to run the alignment

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
GENES="neo_genes" #neo_genes or ancestral_genes 
CLADE="Leptosomiformes" 
WORKING_DIR="/dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/neosex_project/fusion_dating" 
GENE_LIST="$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Lep_dis_Z_list.txt"
SPECIES_LIST="$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species_list"

#first we save the genes we got from TOGA #save to results dir RESULTS_DIR="$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/alignments"

for GENE in $(cat "$GENE_LIST"); do for SPECIES in $(cat "$SPECIES_LIST"); do

    FILE="$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species/$SPECIES/${GENE}"

    if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
        #append
        cat "$FILE" >> "$RESULTS_DIR/$GENE/${GENE}.fasta"
    fi
done

#getting genes from NCBI
Z_DIR="$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/gene_sequences"
if [ -d "$Z_DIR" ]; then
    for Z_FILE_PATH in "$Z_DIR"/*/${GENE}*; do
        if [ -f "$Z_FILE_PATH" ]; then
            # append Z sequence if the filename starts with the gene name
            cat "$Z_FILE_PATH" >> "$RESULTS_DIR/$GENE/${GENE}.fasta"
        fi
    done
fi

done

```
